channel.title: Banks & NBFCs · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Banks & NBFCs in Indian markets. Today: mixed (−0.6).

item.title: [−2] Foreign investors have pulled over ₹3 lakh crore from Indian equities in 2026; selling continues into October
item.description:
FPI outflows passed ₹3 lakh crore in nine months and continued in October. The Nifty fell 3.1% last week to 22,421.95, an eighth straight weekly loss and the longest losing run in 25 years. Escalating.

Banks & NBFCs: headwind (−2) — Heaviest foreign selling in lenders

Why it matters: Persistent foreign selling hits index heavyweights such as large lenders and oil and gas names, pressures the rupee and keeps valuations under strain until global yields ease.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −3, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −2, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] RBI's rate panel begins three-day meeting; 8 of 10 economists expect a hike to 5.50%
item.description:
The MPC meets October 5–7 with the decision due on the 7th. Most economists polled expect a 25-basis-point hike from 5.25%, the first since February 2023. Ongoing: hike expectations have built all week.

Banks & NBFCs: mild tailwind (+1) — Lending margins widen at first

Why it matters: A hike lifts loan rates and G-Sec yields, hitting housing, vehicles and consumer credit, while supporting the rupee and lenders' margins at first. Markets have largely priced it; guidance on further hikes matters most.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Growth outlook −1, Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Sensex opens 431 points higher at 72,340.95 as oil falls and Fed hike fears ease after 8 losing weeks
item.description:
The Sensex opened 0.6% higher and the Nifty 0.49% higher at 22,532.40 on Monday, after eight straight weekly losses, as crude eased and US rate-hike fears faded; India VIX dropped nearly 7%. Reversal, for now.

Banks & NBFCs: mild tailwind (+1) — Banking stocks lead the rebound

Why it matters: Softer crude and fading Fed hike odds ease pressure on the rupee and foreign flows; whether the bounce holds depends on the RBI decision on October 7 and continued FPI selling.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1, Foreign investor flows +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days
